scripts.build: docker build -f Dockerfile --secret id=app_env,src=../.env -t satisfeed-schools:latest .. && docker build -f nginx/Dockerfile --secret id=app_env,src=../.env --build-context certs=certbot -t satisfeed-nginx:latest nginx
scripts.build-local: docker build -f Dockerfile --secret id=app_env,src=../.env -t satisfeed-schools:latest .. && docker build -f nginx/Dockerfile --build-arg BUILD_TYPE=dev -t satisfeed-nginx:latest nginx
